parameters.name: EcrInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance to query.

parameters.name: EcrOwnerId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the ECR instance.

> This parameter is required if you want to load a cross-account network instance.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the network instance to query.

parameters.name: InstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the instance for which to query the authorization relationship. Valid values:

- **VBR**: Virtual Border Router (VBR) instance. Queries the VPC instances for which the VBR instance has been granted authorization.
- **VPC**: virtual private cloud (VPC) instance. Queries the VBR instances to which the VPC instance has granted authorization.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for paginated queries. Valid values: **1** to **100**. Default value: **100**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token for the next query. Valid values:

* Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no more results exist.

* If a next query is available, set this parameter to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region where the network instance to query resides.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource group to which the network instance belongs.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the resource. You must specify at least 1 tag key and can specify at most 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

A tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify at most 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
